title: Rejection probability as a disagreement average
statement: For every natural number $n$, every function $\ell:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2$, and every function $q:\mathbb F_2^{n\times n}\to\mathbb F_2$, one minus the acceptance probability defined by the uniform average over independent uniform $x,y\in\mathbb F_2^n$ and $z\in\mathbb F_2^{n^2}$ equals the uniform average of the indicator that $\ell(x)\ell(y)\ne q(Z)+q(Z+xy^{\mathsf T})$, with $Z$ the matrix obtained by reshaping $z$.
hypotheses_covered: $\ell$ is a function from binary vectors of length $n$ to $\mathbb F_2$
$q$ is a function from binary $n\times n$ matrices to $\mathbb F_2$
